title: Effectiveness of Support Schemes in Helping PMETs Find New Jobs
what_it_is: Effectiveness of Support Schemes in Helping PMETs Find New Jobs

sections.label: Adapt and Grow initiative
sections.summary: The "Adapt and Grow" initiative was announced in April, expanding employment assistance for PMETs and rank-and-file workers through four programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: In anticipation of this, I announced in April this year the "Adapt and Grow" initiative.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: Under "Adapt and Grow", we have enhanced and expanded the package of employment assistance for both the affected professionals, managers, executives and technicians (PMETs) and rank-and-file workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: It includes the Professional Conversion Programme, Career Support Programme, P-Max and Reskilling for Jobs Programme.

sections.label: WSG and jobseekers
sections.summary: About 4,000 PMETs and 6,000 rank-and-file jobseekers secured jobs with WDA and e2i assistance, and WSG will help more Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: With WDA and e2i assistance, about 4,000 PMETs and 6,000 rank-and-file jobseekers have secured jobs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: Moving forward, with the restructuring of WDA into the Workforce Singapore (WSG), we will go beyond helping the unemployed find jobs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: WSG will do more and help more Singaporeans manage their career transitions throughout life.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: WSG will also support tripartite efforts to transform our industries and strengthen the Singaporean Core in all major sectors.

sections.label: Companies weak in Singaporean Core
sections.summary: The passage states these companies are weak in Singaporean Core today, in future commitment to it, and in economic linkage to the economy.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: Minister, we have already past the Parliamentary Question (PQ) and we have already moved on to the next PQ.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: These are companies that are weak in Singaporean Core today, weak in their commitment to strengthen the Singaporean Core in the future, as well as weak in their economic linkage to our economy.
